title: Selection linked integration \(SLI) for endogenous gene tagging and knock sideways in _Plasmodium falciparum_ parasites
protocol: Transfect 50 µg of plasmid DNA using standard procedures.
Select transfected parasites with 4 nM WR99210 to obtain a cell line containing the episomal plasmid.
Generate 1 - 2 cryostabilates once parasitemia exceeds 1%.
Prepare a 5 ml dish with a parasitemia of 1 - 4% and a hematocrit of 5%.
Add 40 µl of G418 solution (400 µg/ml final) to start selection for integrants.
Repeat the preparation of three 5 ml culture dishes in parallel if correct integration is not obtained initially.
Change the medium daily for the first 10 days, then every other day thereafter.
Prepare Giemsa smears the first 3 days after starting selection to ensure parasites do not overgrow excessively.
Dilute the culture moderately (e.g., 1:1) or add 7 ml of RPMI medium if parasitemia exceeds 10%.
Stop G418 selection on day 14-16 and continue culturing without drug pressure.
Wait until parasites re-emerge, usually within 1-3 weeks.
Optional: Add 4 nM WR99210 to the culture for another 2 cell cycles after obtaining G418 resistant parasites.
Prepare gDNA of the integration cell line using a commercial kit.
Check by PCR if integration occurred at the correct locus using genome and vector specific primers for the 5’ and 3’ regions so that the PCR product spans the plasmid/genome junction.
Use genome-specific primers to check that no parasites with the original locus are still present in the culture.
If integration is correct, check localization of the GFP tagged protein with a fluorescence microscope.
Transfect 50 µg of mislocaliser plasmid DNA into the knock-in integration cell line created with pSLI-sandwich or pSLI-2xFKBP-GFP.
Select parasites with 2 µg/ml Blasticidin S or 0.9 µM DSM1, depending on the resistance provided by the chosen mislocaliser plasmid.
Prepare cryostocks when transfectants are obtained.
Assess expression of the mislocaliser using a fluorescence microscope.
Optional: Increase concentration of Blasticidin S to enhance expression of the mislocaliser if it confers Blasticidin S resistance.
Prepare two identical 2 ml cultures in 35x10 mm dishes from the same parental culture.
Add vehicle to one culture as a control.
To the other culture, add 20 μl rapalog working solution resulting in a final concentration of 250nM.
Place both cultures back into the culture incubator.
Check for mislocalisation with a fluorescence microscope after 1 hour and after overnight growth.
If mislocalisation is efficient, carry out flow cytometry growth assay and phenotypic analyses.
Assess parasitemia of the culture to be analysed.
Add 80 μl of RPMI medium to a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Add 1 µl of HO33342 working solution to the 1.5 ml tube.
Add 1 µl of DHE working solution to the 1.5 ml tube.
Thoroughly resuspend the parasite culture by pipetting up and down.
Transfer 20 µl of the resuspended parasite culture into a flow cytometry tube.
Add 80 µl of RPMI dye mix to the flow cytometry tube with the parasite suspension.
Mix the contents of the tube by shaking it.
Incubate for 20 min in the dark.
After incubation, add 400 µl of FC stop solution to the tube.
Shake the tube after adding the stop solution.
Measure the parasitemia to the second decimal place using the LSRII.
Calculate the volume of parasite culture needed for a parasitemia of 0.1% in a total volume of 5 ml based on the obtained parasitemia.
In a 15 ml Falcon tube, prepare 5 ml of the culture at 0.1% parasitemia with 5% hematocrit.
Prepare 2 identical 2 ml cultures from the mixture in the Falcon tube.
To one culture, add vehicle (control).
To the other culture, add 20 µl rapalog working solution (250 nM final).
Place both cultures into the culture incubator.
Carry out steps 1.-6. with the leftover culture mixture remaining in the Falcon tube to assess the exact starting parasitemia of the experiment (day 0).
The next day (day 1), carry out the following for both cultures: change medium, add new rapalog (250 nM final) and assess the parasitemia as described in steps 1.-6.
Repeat step 10 for three more days (days 2-4).
